settlement_verification.service_method: tournaments.settle(roomId, { reason, actor, key }) in packages/services/tournaments.js

global_lock_order.step_1_room_aggregate: Lock room row first via lockRoomRow: SELECT 1 FROM tournament.rooms WHERE room_id=$1 OR code=$1 FOR UPDATE
global_lock_order.step_2_plan_check: Inspect settled/receipt under lock; if already settled, return existing receipt immediately with zero wallet locks
global_lock_order.step_3_wallets_lock: Lock affected actors in ascending order via wallets.lock(sortedActors, { aggregate: { kind: 'tournament', id: room.id } })
global_lock_order.step_4_atomic_commit: Commit room update, wallet credits/debits, ledger entries, burns, tournament records, occupancy release, and outbox event in ONE transaction

indivisible_completion_settlement.result: COMPLETE table settles: 10 payouts credited to wallets, escrow zeroed, exactly 10 ledger entries (<roomId>:payout:<actor>), burn recorded, 10 tournament records updated, occupancy released, outbox event enqueued
indivisible_completion_settlement.idempotent_replay: Replay returns stored receipt with zero duplicate payouts, zero burns, and zero new ledger rows

indivisible_refund.result: VOID/CANCELLED table refunds all 10 entrants: entry fees returned to wallets, escrow zeroed, 10 refund entries (<roomId>:refund:<actor>), 0 burned, 0 placement records, occupancy released, outbox event enqueued

racing_settlers_atomicity.result: Two concurrent settlement workers (Promise.all) serialize on room lock; exactly ONE financial effect committed; wallets paid once, ledger written once, burn recorded once

mid_transaction_crash_rollback.result: Forced failure before commit triggers complete rollback (zero wallets touched, zero ledger rows written, room remains unsettled); subsequent retry commits cleanly once
